integrity.proof_status: Complete analytic proof within the stated model and assumptions
integrity.publication_precedence: Supported by inspected primary literature but not independently certified
integrity.reproducibility: Included standard-library rational verification program; finite checks do not establish the all-dimension theorem

scientific_limitations: One independent Rademacher probe per color; comparison is of variance, not computational cost or tail probabilities.
Only finite positive heat mixtures on an unweighted Boolean hypercube; signed mixtures and other graph geometries are not covered.
A related specialist hierarchical-probing extension could not be fully compared, and independent publication-precedence validation is outstanding.
title: Unique optimal two-color stochastic probing on Boolean hypercubes
